name: Conference Partner API
description: Read-only REST API over the Conference Partner dataset: academic conferences and journals with CFPs, deadlines, locations, CCF / ICORE / QUALIS rankings, curated ranking lists and site statistics. Authentication: search, ranking-list and statistics endpoints need NO credentials — call them directly; anonymous clients share a small daily quota counted per source IP (HTTP 429 when exhausted). The unit is the distinct query: repeating a request already made the same day (same path, same parameters) does not consume quota again. Only the per-venue detail endpoints (/api/conferences/{id}, /api/journals/{id}, /api/researchers/{id}) require a free-account credential — either an API key created at https://www.myhuiban.com/account/api-keys (starts with hb_, never expires, revocable individually) or a JWT from POST /api/login; both are sent as `Authorization: Bearer <credential>` and both raise the daily quota (shared with the MCP server at POST /mcp; HTTP 402 when exhausted). An invalid, revoked or expired credential returns HTTP 401 and is never silently downgraded to the anonymous tier — omit the header entirely to use it. CORS is open on every endpoint. Responses link each venue to its canonical Conference Partner detail_page and do not expose the external website. Send a descriptive User-Agent on every request (e.g. "my-lab-deadline-bot/1.0 (+https://example.edu/contact)"): the site is behind Cloudflare, whose Browser Integrity Check rejects a few unattended-script defaults at the edge with HTTP 403 and body "error code: 1010" before the request reaches the API — confirmed for Python urllib's default (Python-urllib/x.y) and Perl LWP's (libwww-perl/x.y). requests, httpx, curl, Go, Node and Bun clients send their own and are unaffected. A 403 with that body is neither an auth nor a quota error: only a real User-Agent fixes it. Every active conference also carries cp_index, the Conference Partner Index (CP-I): our own transparent 0-100 score with its per-factor breakdown and a confidence value; the complete method is published at https://www.myhuiban.com/ranking. Developer guide: https://www.myhuiban.com/developers — ranking definitions and update cadence: https://www.myhuiban.com/methodology — LLM-oriented site description: https://www.myhuiban.com/llms.txt.
